title: ExternalKey

attachment.title: Attachment
attachment.description: Whether any workspace uses this config to encrypt its data — counting live and archived workspaces (an archived workspace's data remains encrypted under the config), excluding deleted ones. Only an attached config is used by the encryption path; an `unattached` config is inert and can be deleted.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Human-friendly display name. Null if none was set.

geo.title: Geo
geo.description: Data residency geo. Selects the region this key is used in.

id.title: Id
id.description: Identifier of the external key config: a tagged ID prefixed `ekey_`, or, on Claude Platform on AWS, an AWS KMS key's ARN.

provider_config.title: Provider Config
provider_config.description: KMS provider identity and auth coordinates.

user_profile_id.title: User Profile Id
user_profile_id.description: ID of the user profile the key is bound to, or null if the key is not bound to one. A key bound to a user profile can only be attached to a Workspace that has the same user profile. A key that isn't bound can be attached to a Workspace whatever its user profile.

description:
CMEK external key config belonging to the caller's organization.

Configs are organization-scoped. Workspaces attach to a config; once any
workspace references it, the provider fields become effectively immutable
(existing encrypted data needs the config for decrypt).
